License.title: License
License.description: A hashed KamChi license document keyed by HMAC-SHA256(normalizedKey, LICENSE_PEPPER). Plain keys are never stored.

status.description: Current operational status of the license.

issuedAt.description: Timestamp when the license was issued.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when the license expires, or null for lifetime.

maxDevices.description: Maximum number of concurrent activated devices (default pro=2, business=5).

buyerContact.description: Customer Telegram handle, phone number, or email.

notes.description: Internal admin notes such as ABA/KHQR reference.

devices.description: Activated device records ({ deviceId, label, activatedAt, lastSeenAt }).

revokedReason.description: Optional reason recorded when a license is revoked or reissued.

revokedAt.description: Optional timestamp when the license was revoked.

reissuedToPrefix.description: Key hash prefix of the replacement license when reissued.

reissuedFromPrefix.description: Key hash prefix of the superseded license when reissued.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent admin or scheduler update.

AdminAuditLog.title: AdminAuditLog
AdminAuditLog.description: Immutable audit record of admin and scheduled operations on license records. Writable only by Cloud Functions.

actorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin, or 'system:scheduler'.

actorEmail.description: Verified email of the admin, or 'scheduler@system'.

targetKeyHashPrefix.description: First 12 hex characters of the target keyHash (or 'batch').

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the audit log entry.

AdminRateLimit.title: AdminRateLimit
AdminRateLimit.description: Per-admin fixed-window rate limit counter maintained solely by Cloud Functions.

windowStartMs.description: Epoch milliseconds for the current rate-limit window.

count.description: Number of admin requests in the current window.

/licenses/{keyHash}.description: Hashed KamChi licenses. All direct client reads and writes are denied; access is exclusively via Admin SDK callable functions.

/adminAuditLog/{logId}.description: Append-only admin audit log entries. All direct client reads and writes are denied; access is exclusively via Admin SDK callable functions.

/adminRateLimits/{uid}.description: Server-side rate limit counters per admin UID. All direct client reads and writes are denied.
